jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Growth
jobs.snippet: Join Canva's Growth team to develop and deploy ML models for fraud detection, user acquisition, and revenue optimization at global scale.
jobs.description:
## About Canva

Canva is the world's leading visual communication platform, empowering over 200 million users globally to design anything and publish anywhere. The Growth team is responsible for driving user acquisition, engagement, and monetization through data-driven machine learning solutions.

## About the Role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in the Growth team, you will develop and deploy production-grade ML models that power fraud detection, user acquisition targeting, and revenue optimization across Canva's global platform. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and software engineers to ship impactful AI-driven features.

## Responsibilities

- Design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning models for fraud detection and prevention
- Develop user lifetime value (LTV) prediction models to optimize growth campaigns
- Build recommendation and personalization systems to improve conversion and retention
- Partner with data engineers to build robust feature pipelines and training infrastructure
- Define and track success metrics for ML-driven product experiments
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team's technical direction

## Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering in production environments
- Strong proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Proven experience deploying ML models at scale (millions of users)
- Experience with MLOps tooling including feature stores, model serving, and monitoring
- Deep understanding of model evaluation, A/B testing, and causal inference
- Experience with fraud detection, anomaly detection, or growth-oriented ML is highly valued

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow), Spark, Kubernetes, Airflow

## Benefits

- Equity package + competitive base salary
- Flexible hybrid work (Sydney campus + remote across ANZ)
- Catered lunches, wellness allowance, learning budget
- Generous parental leave and mental health support

jobs.title: Staff Applied Scientist
jobs.snippet: Shape the AI/ML strategy at Canva as a Staff Applied Scientist, leading research and development of user-facing AI features including design generation and multimodal understanding.
jobs.description:
## About the Role

Canva is seeking a Staff Applied Scientist to drive AI/ML innovation across the platform. This is a senior individual contributor role where you'll partner with product teams to define and execute the AI strategy for user-facing features such as AI-assisted design generation, multimodal understanding, and personalisation at scale.

## What You'll Do

- Research and develop AI/ML solutions that directly power Canva's most impactful user-facing features
- Partner on developing an AI/ML strategy across product areas, influencing roadmap and technical direction
- Lead development of natural language understanding/processing systems for creative workflows
- Publish or present research findings internally and at major ML conferences
- Drive technical excellence through architecture reviews, design docs, and mentorship
- Work closely with foundation model teams and product engineers to ship production AI at scale

## Who We're Looking For

- PhD or equivalent research experience in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field
- Demonstrated track record shipping production AI/ML systems at global scale
- Deep expertise in at least one of: NLP/LLM fine-tuning, multimodal models, generative AI, or recommender systems
- Experience designing and running large-scale ML experiments and ablation studies
- Strong communication skills — able to present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Prior experience at a Staff+ or Principal level in industry

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, JAX, GCP (TPUs, Vertex AI), Kubernetes, internal ML platforms

## Benefits

- Remote across ANZ or hybrid from Sydney/Melbourne campus
- Equity + competitive total compensation
- Annual learning budget, conference attendance support
- Flexible working hours and generous leave policies

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer / Staff Applied Scientist
jobs.snippet: Lead Rokt's machine learning science function, combining technical leadership with hands-on model development to power the world's leading e-commerce transaction network.
jobs.description:
## About Rokt

Rokt is a market-leading e-commerce technology company that leverages machine learning to power highly relevant transaction moments for global partners. Trusted by major brands like Uber, American Airlines, Ticketmaster, Macy's, and Live Nation, Rokt processes millions of transactions daily using AI to match customers with the right offers at the right time.

## About the Role

As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer / Staff Applied Scientist, you will combine deep technical expertise with strategic leadership to guide Rokt's ML science function. You'll be a key technical voice shaping how ML is applied across Rokt's transaction network, working at the intersection of research and production engineering.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead a team of ML engineers and scientists, setting technical direction and best practices
- Design and implement next-generation ranking, recommendation, and causal ML models
- Drive the ML research agenda, from ideation through to production impact at scale
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define ML-driven solutions for revenue optimization
- Serve as a technical advisor on model architecture, training infrastructure, and deployment strategy
- Contribute to hiring, mentoring, and growing the ML talent pipeline

## Requirements

- 7+ years of ML engineering experience, with 2+ years in a lead or staff-level role
- Deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, or causal inference
- Strong fundamentals in statistics, optimization, and large-scale distributed ML training
- Experience shipping high-throughput, low-latency ML systems in production
- Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting at the executive level

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, AWS (SageMaker, S3, Kinesis), Kubernetes, MLflow

## Benefits

- Competitive salary + significant equity
- Hybrid work from Rokt's Sydney CBD office
- Annual overseas team trips, learning budget, and health insurance

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build and deploy ML models powering Rokt's real-time transaction marketing platform, working with petabyte-scale data to optimise e-commerce offers for millions of customers daily.

Rokt is a global e-commerce technology company that uses ML to power transaction moments at scale. Its technology is embedded in the checkout flows of major retailers and service providers worldwide, serving personalised offers to over 3 billion transactions per year.

- Hybrid Sydney CBD office with flexible arrangements

- Health insurance and wellness perks

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Drive advanced data science and AI solutions for Analytic Partners' marketing analytics platform, helping global brands measure and optimise their marketing investments.
jobs.description:
## About Analytic Partners

Analytic Partners is a global leader in commercial analytics, helping over 700 brands worldwide make smarter marketing investment decisions. The company's flagship platform, ROI Genome, applies advanced data science, machine learning, and econometrics to provide actionable insights for the world's largest advertisers.

## About the Role

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced data science and AI solutions for Analytic Partners' clients across Australia and globally. You'll sit within the Asia-Pacific team, working across offices in Sydney and Melbourne.

## Responsibilities

- Design and deploy advanced ML models for marketing mix modelling (MMM), attribution, and forecasting
- Work directly with client partners to understand business problems and translate them into data science solutions
- Develop automation and AI tooling to accelerate analytical workflows
- Contribute to the development of Analytic Partners' proprietary data science platform
- Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the team's technical standards
- Present findings and recommendations to C-suite stakeholders at major brands

## Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in data science or applied ML
- Strong programming skills in Python (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Demonstrable experience with time-series modelling, Bayesian inference, or causal ML
- Experience in commercial analytics, marketing measurement, or econometrics is strongly preferred

Base $95,000–$120,000 AUD per year plus annual cash bonus and equity

## Benefits

- Hybrid work (Sydney or Melbourne)
- Global exposure — work with clients across APAC, US, and EMEA
- Collaborative, high-performance culture with strong mentorship

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Apply deep learning and computer vision to automate inspection of underground infrastructure — help VAPAR's AI power asset health decisions for over 2 million metres of pipe worldwide.
jobs.description:
## About VAPAR

VAPAR is an Australian deep-tech company that accelerates asset health improvements for wastewater and drainage networks by leveraging AI and automation. Their technology empowers clients to rapidly find and fix problematic underground assets before they fail, having powered asset health investments on over 2 million metres of pipe across Australia, UK, US, and New Zealand.

## About the Role

VAPAR is seeking an experienced Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience to join their remote-first AI team. You'll work at the intersection of deep learning, computer vision, and data engineering to build the models that drive VAPAR's core product — automated CCTV pipe inspection and defect classification.

## Key Responsibilities

- Develop, test, and maintain model training, testing, and inference code for computer vision tasks
- Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights in pipe inspection data
- Extract, transform, and load data from various sources to build high-quality training datasets
- Iterate on defect detection and classification models to improve accuracy and reliability
- Build data pipelines that support the full machine learning lifecycle
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate model outputs into product features

## Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of experience in data science or applied ML
- Strong Python programming skills (PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, pandas)
- 1–2 years hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks
- Proven track record in data engineering and model development
- Experience with computer vision or image/video analysis is a strong plus
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, AWS (S3, Lambda), Docker, PostgreSQL

## Benefits

- Fully remote role (Australia-based)
- Genuine career growth opportunities in a fast-scaling deep-tech startup
- Work on real-world AI that prevents infrastructure failures

jobs.title: Senior AI Applied Engineer
jobs.snippet: Design and deliver AI-powered features at Envato, improving development tools and enhancing customer workflows across the world's leading marketplace for creative assets.
jobs.description:

Envato is the world's leading marketplace for creative assets and tools, connecting millions of creatives with the digital resources they need. Headquartered in Melbourne, Envato's platform — including Envato Market, Elements, and Placeit — serves over 12 million customers globally. The company is investing heavily in AI to transform the creative experience for its customers and internal teams.

## About the Role

As a Senior AI Applied Engineer, you will design and deliver innovative AI-powered experiences that enhance customer workflows and improve internal processes across Envato's platform. You'll work collaboratively across product, design, and engineering teams to bring AI innovation from concept to production.

## What You'll Do

- Design and build production-grade AI features including content recommendation, intelligent search, and generative tools
- Improve developer tooling through AI-assisted code generation and review processes
- Evaluate and integrate foundation models (LLMs, diffusion models) into Envato's product suite
- Develop AI evaluation frameworks to ensure quality, safety, and relevance at scale
- Partner with product managers and data scientists to define and prioritise AI opportunities
- Contribute to Envato's internal AI platform and engineering standards

## Requirements

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years in applied AI/ML roles
- Strong Python expertise; experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning
- Experience deploying AI systems at scale in cloud environments (AWS or GCP)
- Strong engineering fundamentals including software design, testing, and observability

## Tech Stack

Python, LangChain, OpenAI / Anthropic APIs, AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, SageMaker), PostgreSQL, React

## Benefits

- Flexible hybrid work (Melbourne HQ + remote options)
- Competitive salary, $5K annual learning budget
- Health and wellbeing allowance, generous parental leave
- A collaborative culture with a strong creative mission

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - AI
jobs.snippet: Lead Envato's AI product strategy as Principal PM, defining the vision and roadmap for how AI transforms the creative experience for millions of customers worldwide.

jobs.title: Founding AI / Software Engineer
jobs.snippet: Own the technical direction of Synetic Studio's agentic AI video editing platform — build LLM-powered systems that let creators upload footage and receive polished content in minutes.
jobs.description:
## About Synetic Studio

Synetic Studio is a Brisbane-based AI startup revolutionising how content creators produce short-form video content. Their agentic AI editing platform, powered by Wizzy — an AI assistant that understands a creator's unique style — allows users to upload footage, describe their vision, and receive platform-ready content in minutes. The company is participating in the 2026 QLD AI Hub Launch AI Pre-Accelerator and is approaching its beta release.

## About the Role

This is the founding AI/Software Engineering role at Synetic Studio. You'll own the technical direction of the core product, reporting directly to the founder. This is a rare opportunity for an AI engineer who wants to architect agentic systems from the ground up, with full authority over the tech stack, framework choices, and infrastructure decisions.

## Responsibilities

- Design and build the end-to-end AI backend powering the conversational video editing platform
- Architect and implement agentic systems using LangGraph, DSPy, and emerging agent frameworks
- Build RAG pipelines for personalised creator media understanding and style matching
- Develop multimodal AI features for video understanding, clip selection, and timeline generation
- Own the cloud infrastructure and MLOps for model serving and fine-tuning
- Drive the technical roadmap in collaboration with the founder

## Requirements

- AI/ML experience in generative models, computer vision, or temporal media (video, audio)
- Deep generative AI knowledge: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, QLoRA fine-tuning
- Experience with embeddings, vector search, chunking, and relevance tuning
- Strong Python backend engineering fundamentals
- Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration

## Compensation

$130K–$200K AUD depending on experience + significant early-stage equity

## Benefits

- Work directly with the founder, high ownership and autonomy
- Flexible arrangements, Brisbane office + remote
- Stock options in a well-backed AI startup at an exciting early stage

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build and extend DroneShield's deep learning models for drone detection and classification, maintaining inference pipelines used in live defence and security deployments globally.
jobs.description:
## About DroneShield

DroneShield (ASX: DRO) is a mission-driven company advancing AI, RF sensing, and counter-UAS technology for defence and security applications. The company has grown from 11 employees in 2017 to over 450 globally in 2026, with headquarters in Pyrmont, Sydney. Revenue has surged from A$57M in 2024 to over A$190M in 2025, reflecting hypergrowth demand for its AI-powered drone detection and defeat systems.

## About the Role

As an AI/ML Engineer at DroneShield, you will maintain, refine, and extend cutting-edge deep learning models and inference pipelines that power real-world drone detection systems deployed by defence forces and security organisations worldwide.

## Responsibilities

- Maintain, refine, and extend existing deep learning models for drone detection, classification, and RF signature analysis
- Evaluate and benchmark model performance on curated datasets and real-world operational scenarios
- Develop data augmentation strategies and model fine-tuning approaches to improve detection accuracy
- Collaborate with RF sensing and systems engineers to integrate AI into end-to-end detection pipelines
- Support MLOps pipeline development for continuous model improvement and deployment
- Contribute to technical documentation and IP development

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in ML engineering or applied deep learning
- Strong proficiency in Python with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Experience with computer vision, object detection (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), or signal classification
- Understanding of model inference optimisation (quantisation, TensorRT, ONNX)
- Must be eligible for Australian security clearance (Australian citizen or permanent resident preferred)
- Defence or security sector experience is a plus

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA, TensorRT, AWS, Docker, Git

## Benefits

- Competitive salary with stock options (ASX listed)
- Pyrmont Sydney office with catered dinners, unlimited snacks
- Superannuation contributions, health benefits
- Work on technology that protects lives

jobs.title: Data Engineer – SensorFusionAI
jobs.snippet: Build the data infrastructure and MLOps pipelines that power DroneShield's SensorFusion AI — turning real-world multi-sensor data into actionable AI intelligence for drone detection.
jobs.description:

DroneShield's SensorFusionAI team is building the next generation of multi-sensor AI intelligence — fusing radar, RF, optical, and acoustic data to provide unmatched drone detection capability. As a Data Engineer on this team, you will own the data infrastructure and MLOps pipelines that turn raw sensor data into the high-quality AI intelligence that powers DroneShield's products.

- Develop core data pipelines and tools that transform real-world multi-sensor data into actionable AI intelligence
- Create automated workflows (CI/CD, DataOps) and AI/ML pipelines (MLOps) for continuous model training and deployment
- Design and implement data schemas, storage solutions, and ETL processes for large-scale sensor datasets
- Build and maintain feature engineering pipelines for downstream ML model training
- Monitor data quality, lineage, and pipeline reliability in production environments
- Collaborate closely with ML engineers to ensure data infrastructure meets model training needs

## Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in data engineering or ML infrastructure roles
- Strong Python skills and experience with data processing frameworks (Spark, Flink, Beam)
- Experience designing and implementing MLOps pipelines (MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar)
- Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible)
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
- Eligibility for Australian security clearance preferred

## Tech Stack

Python, Apache Spark, Kafka, MLflow, AWS (S3, Glue, SageMaker), Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL

## Benefits

- Competitive salary + ASX stock options
- Pyrmont Sydney office, catered meals, modern facilities
- Work on mission-critical AI for national security

jobs.title: Graduate Field Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Launch your data engineering career at DroneShield — deliver high-quality datasets that support the ML lifecycle for proprietary drone detection algorithms, working alongside RF and AI engineers.
jobs.description:

DroneShield is seeking a Graduate Field Data Engineer to join the team in Sydney (Pyrmont). You'll work alongside RF engineers, AI researchers, and product teams to collect, process, and validate field data from real-world deployments.

- Build and maintain data collection scripts and processing pipelines
- Conduct data quality checks to ensure dataset integrity for ML model training

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (recent graduate or final-year student)
- Proficiency in Python and SQL
- Familiarity with data processing libraries (pandas, NumPy) and basic ML concepts
- Strong attention to detail and data quality focus
- Willingness to occasionally travel for field data collection activities
- Australian citizenship or permanent residency (security clearance eligibility required)

Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, AWS S3, Git

## Benefits

- Competitive graduate starting salary
- Mentorship from experienced ML and RF engineers
- Exposure to cutting-edge defence AI technology from day one
- Career progression pathway in a fast-growing ASX-listed company

jobs.title: AI ML Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build and deploy AI/ML/NLP solutions for Infosys enterprise clients in Melbourne, with a focus on conversational AI, customer-facing chatbots, and intelligent automation.
jobs.description:

jobs.title: AI Engineer

jobs.title: AI芯片软件算法工程师（暑期实习）
jobs.snippet: 加入壁仞科技AI软件平台团队，参与国产高端GPU芯片的AI推理框架、编译优化和算法适配工作，推动大模型在壁仞GPU上的高效部署。
jobs.description:

壁仞科技成立于2019年，是国产高端GPU芯片领域的头部企业，致力于研发原创性的通用计算体系，在智能计算领域提供一体化的软硬件解决方案。公司已获融资超47亿元，荣获卓越职场认证，base城市包括上海、北京、杭州、珠海、成都。

## 岗位职责

- 参与壁仞GPU芯片AI推理框架的研发与优化
- 负责大模型（LLM/AIGC）在壁仞平台的适配、移植与性能调优
- 开发并优化CUDA/壁仞GPU算子（卷积、注意力机制、激活函数等）
- 参与深度学习编译器（TVM、MLIR等）对接与算子融合优化
- 分析大模型推理性能瓶颈，提出并实施优化方案
- 编写技术文档和测试用例，保障代码质量

## 岗位要求

- 计算机、电子信息、数学等相关专业在读本科生/研究生（2027届可转正）
- 熟悉Python/C++，了解CUDA或并行计算基础
- 了解深度学习基础理论及常见框架（PyTorch、TensorFlow）
- 有大模型推理优化、量化（INT8/FP16）、TensorRT等相关经验者优先
- 能保证每周3天以上出勤，实习期3个月以上

## 技术栈

Python, C++, CUDA, PyTorch, TensorRT, MLIR, TVM

## 薪资福利

- 日薪有竞争力，实习期间享有餐补、超大健身房等福利
- 提供转正绿通，优秀实习生直接转正
